newsitem.title: USA: Irvine Apartment files $350 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Irvine Apartment files $350 mln shelf.

text.p: Irvine Apartment Communities Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registation to sell up to $350 million in debt securities, preferred and common stock.
The new registration includes $99,105,912 worth of securities carried over from a previous filing.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including the repayment of debt, ongoing development activities and acquisitions of additional properties, Irvine said in the filing.

Irvine is a self-administered equity real estate investment trust engaged in the development and operation of apartment communities on the Irvine Ranch in Orange County, Calif and others also in California.
